query_analysis.original_query: We're experiencing unexpected temperature profile variations in our atmospheric distillation unit. Can you help diagnose potential root causes?
query_analysis.expanded_query: Investigate and diagnose the underlying causes of temperature profile anomalies in an atmospheric distillation unit, focusing on identifying potential sources of thermal instability

selected_agents.role: Root cause investigation of temperature variations
Thermal profile analysis and mechanism identification

communication_strategy.information_flow: Sequential diagnostic cross-referencing and hypothesis testing

clarification_questions: When did these temperature profile variations first become noticeable?
Can you provide specific details about the observed temperature deviations?
Have there been any recent changes in feed composition or operating conditions?
What are the current temperature ranges at different stages of the distillation unit?
